F1_filler_token_match: the arm-F notes block is tuned to the endpoint's measured prompt_tokens: probe 1 at the draft's whitespace-token budget n0 (cap 1), and out of band one registered rescale n1 = round(n0 * (pt_X - pt_B) / (pt_F@n0 - pt_B)) (2 * n0 when the measured increment is not positive), probed once; at most two probes per armed cell; the realized counts and probe lengths are recorded per record (fields filler_tokens, filler_probe_lengths)
H1_answer_stability: over the terminal cells whose turn-1 answer WAS the terminal gold: how often each arm still reports the interior step correctly (the arm-damages-a-right-answer side, issue #152 item 3)
P1_prompt_tokens_parity: every arm user turn is the FULL turn-1 prompt, so the four arms differ only in the notes block; per armed cell the measured endpoint prompt_tokens of X, C and F spread by at most 400 tokens and all three exceed arm B's while the context-length claim in the README ships; violation ships it downgraded to context_length_unmatched (the round-75 reading, registered as the fallback outcome)
V0_precondition: the deployment must hand back a non-report channel at the pre-gate census; without it arms X and C cannot be built and row C2 is refused, not trusted (issue #105)
V1_solver_certified: the independent solver agrees with the path walk at j = 0, 1, mid, level and returns None one step past the tail; every item is a load-floor (facts = 2 * level), component-isomorphic two-chain item; the interior gold is asserted distinct from the terminal and the start; the filler token is asserted outside every vocabulary; for each interior cell the asked interior gold is asserted absent from the donor item's vocabulary, so a whole donor draft can never contain the asked gold (the item vocabularies are not pairwise disjoint; the asserted property is the narrower gold-leak one, recorded per donor pair)
V2_control_liveness: the past-the-tail control declares NONE at turn 1 (issue #139 shape)
V3_anchor: the shallow j = 8 anchor cell delivers the correct terminal (liveness)
X2_tail_shortcut: if every delivered arm-X record on the scope emitted the own draft's last vocabulary name, the reading is tail_copy, not selection; on the interior ask a tail copy is a wrong answer, so the downgrade and a correct recovery are mutually exclusive. The foreign analogue on arm C is a census (field answer_is_foreign_tail): a foreign-tail copy is a wrong answer by construction

arms.B: turn-1 answer field only in the assistant turn
arms.C: turn-1 answer field plus a draft of a DIFFERENT item, used WHOLE and uncut under the same label (a donor chosen for prompt-token parity by taking the donor's cap-censored draft whole, instead of the round-75 whitespace-token cut; donor map frozen below)
arms.F: turn-1 answer field plus a tokenization-aware filler under the same label: the block starts at the draft's whitespace-token budget and is tuned by at most two registered probes at cap 1 to sit within the P1 band of arm X's measured prompt_tokens
arms.X: turn-1 answer field plus the item's own turn-1 non-report channel under the notes label in the assistant turn (the own draft)

controls_C1: a name emitted where the links ran out is a manufactured name; the NONE-gold control runs under all four arms, drafts included, and any false name caps the C2 reading

decision_C2.evaluable_scope: the terminal cells whose turn-1 draft contains the interior gold, census field interior_gold_in_trace, registered here before any prompt
decision_C2.own_content_selects: n_X >= 2 and n_X - n_C >= 2 (the item's own draft outperforms the foreign scaffold by two or more: content-specific recovery)
decision_C2.scaffold_carries: n_C >= 1 and n_C >= n_X - 1 (the foreign scaffold does the work at parity: a name-scaffold lookup posture)
decision_C2.statistics: exact two-sided binomial over the X-vs-C discordant pairs across the items, exploratory, n single digits, no significance claim

decision_R2.evaluable_scope: the terminal cells whose turn-1 draft contains the interior gold, census field interior_gold_in_trace, registered here before any prompt
decision_R2.no_recovery: n_X == 0 (zero correct recoveries is no_recovery by definition; an all-tail result at n_X == 0 is also no_recovery, since there is no recovery to downgrade)
decision_R2.statistics: exact two-sided binomial over the X-vs-F discordant pairs across the three items, exploratory, n single digits, no significance claim
decision_R2.tail_copy_downgrade: n_X >= 2 and every delivered arm-X record on the scope emitted the draft's last vocabulary name (the cross_ask_gated case where all recoveries are tail copies; refs #166, the trigger aligned to the code)
decision_R2.censored_not_a_miss: arm cells whose finish_reason is length (censored at the cap, no delivery inside the budget) are excluded from the contrast denominator and reported as censored_at_cap, not counted as misses; refs #145
decision_R2.control_own_budget: the NONE-gold control gets its own per-control budget CONTROL_MAX_TOKENS, not the deep cells' max_tokens; a control whose own budget is exhausted ships not_delivered, not a censored-miss; refs #139
decision_R2.fallback_provenance: the reasoning-fallback token's first-occurrence position in the trace is recorded and classified own-channel vs donor-block; a token sourced from the restored donor block is not the model's own reasoning provenance; refs #94
